connection.failed: {{marketplace}}: the last order import failed — {{error}}. An empty row for this marketplace means a failed import, not an absence of orders.
connection.rate_limited: {{marketplace}}: the marketplace refused to serve orders right now (rate limit). That is neither a failure nor an absence of orders — some orders of the period may not be imported yet. Run the import again later.
connection.noErrorText: the marketplace sent no error text
connection.fixture: {{marketplace}}: these rows come from recorded answers (fixtures), not from the marketplace.

detail.readOnly: View only. Change the order in the marketplace's own cabinet.
detail.statusChangedUnknown: the marketplace does not say when
detail.noLines: This order has no lines, which is an import defect rather than an empty order. Check the last import.
detail.historyHint: What we saw at each import. Neither Wildberries nor Ozon hands out a status log, so the time here is ours.

wildberries.title: Wildberries
wildberries.subtitle: the seller cabinet: the key, what it may do, and what is already mirrored here
wildberries.expiringSoon: The Wildberries key expires in {{days}} days — ask the seller to reissue it in the WB cabinet

sync.title: Last import
sync.hint: the wb:sync script fetches the data; this is its last run per kind

statuses.rateLimitedUntil: waiting for the WB window until {{time}}

mirrors.title: How much is mirrored here
mirrors.hint: a copy of the cabinet in our database; nothing is ever written back to Wildberries

endpoints.title: What we may ask Wildberries for
endpoints.hint: the whole list; anything else is refused by the code before a socket is opened

write.title: Writing to Wildberries
write.hint: off entirely for now: five gates must be open before a single request reaches WB. Two of them are yours — the switch and a consent per operation class.

gate.noKey: no separate write key (slot {{slot}}); the read key is never used to write
gate.liveOff: {{env}} is not set: every call stays a dry run and nothing leaves the process

switch.label: Allow writing to Wildberries for this shop
switch.onToast: Switch is on. Writing still will not happen: the other gates are shut.

consent.title: Consents per operation class
consent.grantBody: You are confirming that the platform may {{what}}. This covers only these calls: {{methods}}. A consent applies to one operation class and never to the others. Today nothing will be sent regardless: there is no separate write key and live mode is off.
consent.revokeBody: The consent for “{{name}}” will be deleted. Every call of that class is refused afterwards.
consent.note: The owner confirmed: {{what}}. Calls in this class: {{count}}.
consent.notGiven: no consent — calls of this class are refused

stocks.title: Stocks
stocks.does: update and delete item inventory on Wildberries warehouses

prices.title: Prices
prices.does: send new prices and discounts to Wildberries

feedback_answers.title: Feedback answers
feedback_answers.does: publish and edit answers to customer feedback

fbs_orders.title: FBS orders
fbs_orders.does: cancel FBS orders and hand supplies over to delivery

audit.title: Attempt journal
audit.hint: every write attempt, whatever came of it. “Dry run” means nothing left the process.

sales.title: Sales and returns this month
sales.hint: the WB statistics feed for the last {{days}} days; the data is preliminary, accurate money lives in the realization report
sales.empty: no sales in this period — either the import has not run, or WB returned nothing

questions.title: Customer questions
questions.hint: the ones waiting for an answer come first; answering happens in the WB cabinet, this platform cannot write to Wildberries
questions.empty: no questions — either the import has not run, or WB returned nothing

funnel.title: Funnel by listing
funnel.hint: card opens, adds to cart, orders and buyouts per day, from the seller-analytics report
funnel.window: {{from}} — {{to}}, {{listings}} of {{total}} listings in the table (WB answers for at most 20 listings per request)
funnel.noWindow: period unknown: the analytics import has not run yet
funnel.empty: no funnel data — either the import has not run, or WB returned nothing

fbs.title: FBS orders
fbs.hint: assembly orders and supplies from the Wildberries cabinet. This is our copy: the list comes from our own database, so reloading the page does not spend the shop's request budget.

sync.howTo: the import is a script: WB_KIND=supplies,fbs_orders pnpm --filter backend wb:sync

wbStatuses.canceled_by_client: cancelled by the buyer on receipt
wbStatuses.declined_by_client: cancelled by the buyer within the hour

assemble.title: Assemble {{count}} order(s)
assemble.intoSupply: The orders are added to the supply «{{supply}}» and move to the in-assembly status. Wildberries has no separate confirm method: adding an order to a supply IS confirming it. Nothing leaves this process today, the live mode is off and the attempt is journalled as a dry run.
assemble.newSupply: No supply is chosen, so a new one is created first and {{count}} order(s) are then added to it and moved to the in-assembly status. Nothing leaves this process today, the live mode is off and the attempt is journalled as a dry run.

cancel.title: Cancel {{count}} order(s)
cancel.body: Orders {{orders}} move to the cancelled-by-the-seller status. Cancelling is possible only before the order is handed over to Wildberries. Nothing leaves this process today, the live mode is off and the attempt is journalled as a dry run.

deliver.title: Hand the supply «{{supply}}» over for delivery
deliver.body: The supply closes and all {{count}} order(s) move to the in-delivery status. Nothing can be added to it afterwards, and Wildberries calls the action irreversible. Nothing leaves this process today, the live mode is off and the attempt is journalled as a dry run.

gates.consentGiven: The consent for the FBS orders class was given on the Connection tab.
gates.consentMissing: The consent for the FBS orders class has not been given. It can be confirmed on the Connection tab; without it every attempt is refused at the consent gate.

result.dryRun: Dry run: nothing left this process
result.dryRunToast: The attempt is in the journal. Nothing was sent to Wildberries.
